notes: «عَنْهُ» at the start is a back_reference to the previous report's last teacher; no previous report is supplied in the context and it does not carry the flag, so no names are inherited; «مِثْلَهُ» says the saying repeats the previous route; the second route begins after the full stop and is its own group; «أَحَدِهِمَا» is a pronoun for one of the two Imams and is unnamed; «وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى» is a co-transmitter of «علي بن أبي حمزة»
